description: List the conferences published on Congressio — name, slug, dates, timezone, venue, organizer, and whether the program is published. Needs no credentials. Use this to answer 'which conferences are open', to find a conference by name, or to get the slug that get_public_conference needs. Returns only publicly visible conferences, so a user's own draft events will NOT appear here — use list_my_events for those.

offset.description: How many to skip, for paging.

name: list_public_conferences
title: List public conferences
